## History

Violetta was imagined as a little girl who lived in an echo near Mrs. Hammond's house. She was considered a great friend, loved almost as much as [Katie Maurice](../character/katie-maurice.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043)_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--violetta.md)

Violetta is an imaginary friend created by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) from an echo. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) conceives of Violetta as a companion, giving a name and identity to her own reflected voice.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043)_
